offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures lithium-ion battery cells, battery packs and battery systems for commercial vehicles, energy storage and industrial equipment. Sells mainly to vehicle and equipment makers and energy system integrators, delivering custom battery solutions built to customer specifications.

primary_products.value: lithium-ion battery cells; battery packs; battery systems for commercial vehicles; energy storage systems

primary_services.value: battery system engineering and testing support

customer_segment.value: B2B: commercial vehicle and bus makers, mining and industrial equipment makers, energy storage integrators

end_markets.value: commercial vehicles; energy storage; mining and industrial equipment; transportation

revenue_model.value: product sales: battery cells, packs and systems sold to vehicle and equipment makers and energy integrators

value_chain_position.value: component supplier: sells battery cells and packs that customers integrate into their vehicles and systems; OEM / manufacturer: manufactures its own battery cells and packs from raw materials, sold to vehicle and equipment makers

geography_served.value: global: China, United States, Europe and other export markets

specialization.value: niche specialist: lithium-ion battery technology and battery systems for commercial and industrial applications

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct sales teams and engineering contracts with OEM customers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: battery safety, transport of lithium batteries and environmental rules, such as UN transport testing and product safety standards
